contributions.detail: 3 Form A rows (825.00 + 50.00 + 268.13) sum to 1,143.13 = the cover's This-Report cell exactly. The 2026 form variant prints NO schedule-level total on Form A itself, so the cover's matching-scope cell IS the anchor; no figure was synthesized by differencing covers. Period-scoped: the cover's Last-Report column carries 23,859.94 forward from this OFFICEHOLDER's earlier account, and 23,859.94 + 1,143.13 = 25,003.07 = the printed Cumulative Total, so the cover's own arithmetic closes and the pre-2026 money is simply not itemized here. No in-kind line on the sheet, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the same 1,143.13.

itemized.notes: Ricky D. Hatch, Weber County Clerk/Auditor, 2026 cycle, '7 days before the candidates' convention - Convention' report, signed April 3, 2026. This is the NEW 2026 FORM VARIANT: an unrotated portrait cover with a boxed 'Campaign Financial Summary' (Last Report / This Report / Cumulative Total) and machine-typed spreadsheet schedules - Form A on p2 (Date | Name of Contributor | Address | Amount) and Form B on p3 (Purchase Date | Person/Organization | City | Purpose | Amount). NEITHER schedule prints a total of its own, unlike every earlier Weber form; the cover's matching-scope This-Report cell is therefore the only printed anchor for each side, and both close exactly. All three contribution rows are the candidate's OWN LOANS to the campaign, so this filing itemizes no third-party donor at all. The cover here is NOT redacted by the county (unusual in this corpus) and prints the candidate's street address; Form A repeats that address on all three rows. Per PRIVACY.md only city/state are carried - and the city is 'Ogden Valley City, UT', the municipality incorporated off the 2024 ballot (weber_county's Ogden Valley incorporation watch item), which is a genuine source property worth noting: 2026 filings start carrying the new city name for addresses that earlier filings would have written as Eden/Huntsville/unincorporated Weber. Form B's Purchase Date column carries NO YEAR at all ('31-Dec', '2-Jan', '30-Jan', '11-Feb'); those are kept verbatim and the build will blank them with needs_review rather than inferring 2025/2026 from the report date.
